summary:
Fixed direct check (action=check) for unit-claim-client-future-shutdown-escape, preflight-validated with valid=True and no diagnostics.

Design: plan_c8.json plus harness_shutdown_test.go build a node with background goroutines disabled (skipStartup), BatchApplyCh enabled and a buffered apply channel, call Apply so the request is accepted, then call Shutdown and probe the returned future without blocking — recording whether a response is available on the future's channel, whether it carries the shutdown escape, and the derived caller_can_complete. Declarative prerequisite: request_accepted true. Monitor applicability: request_accepted true. Property: an accepted request has a completion path, identity op_id, evaluated from emitted fields rather than tests_passed. A control on a served single-node cluster performs the same call and completes, so a negative result is attributable to the dropped request rather than to the client API itself.

Construction evidence (not the formal observation): a local run in a copy of the captured module shows caller_can_complete false with responded_after_shutdown false and shutdown_escape false, while the served control reports completed true — i.e. the mechanism by which a caller would block forever is absent for the future the library returned.

Declared adaptations: skipStartup makes an accepted-then-dropped request deterministic instead of relying on a shutdown race; BatchApplyCh with MaxAppendEntries gives the documented buffered channel; and the probe reads the future's own fields rather than calling Error(), which would block, so this is a state observation of the mechanism rather than a timing observation.

Retained uncertainties: whether VerifyLeader's verifyFuture, configurationChangeFuture and userSnapshotFuture share the gap; whether completion after Shutdown is intentionally not guaranteed (which would make the correct disposition a documented caveat); and the plan carries that alternative plus the Future.Error documentation conflict. No target code was modified; fresh execution plus a checker-correspondence review still remain.
